assets.description: Authored once per game or scene and reused by every take.

first_frame.description: <Picture 1>: scene concept art from the engine's opening camera view; same framing as proxy frame 0.

look.description: Noun phrase for the subject's appearance.

pronoun.description: Fills {he} {him} {his} (and capitalised forms) in the action text.

skills.description: Skill tree: engine mechanic -> how this character realizes it.

text.description: Verb phrase, from the gesture that starts the skill to its effect on the target; {target} is replaced by the event target's entity text.

again.description: Shorter verb phrase for a repeat within the same caption. Default: text + ' again'.

phases.description: Optional sentence-level text per phase, used through {skill:<mechanic>.<phase>}: windup, release and recover are verb phrases of the character; travel, impact and decay (how the effect clears off the target) are clauses with their own subject. A missing impact falls back to text; name reads the skill name.

pose.description: Engine-side gesture the proxy body plays for this skill (training ground: see games/training_ground/render.py POSES); the VM never reads it.

kind.description: Engine-side: whether the proxy shows the shot flying (projectile) or only its landing (at_target, e.g. lightning from the sky).

moves.description: How this character moves: kind -> verb phrase; kinds without an entry use the engine's plain phrase. walk_to and turn_to take {target}.

take.description: Produced by the engine at run time.

video.description: <Video 1>: proxy rendered from the player camera, any fps (resampled to the model's fps).

seconds.description: Trim the proxy to this length.

entities.description: Entity id -> noun phrase. 'player' is implicit.

t.description: Seconds from the take's first frame.

detail.description: Engine-specific numbers (damage, hp, ...); not used in text.

action.description: What happens, one entry per segment or one shared by all. Placeholders: {skill:<mechanic>}, {skill:<mechanic>><entity>}, {target:<entity>}, {move:<kind>}, {move:<kind>><entity>}.
